build_timestep_embedding: build sinusoidal timestep embeddings for diffusion models given timesteps and embedding dimension
create_cond_embedding: create time and condition embeddings by combining sinusoidal timestep embeddings with optional conditioning input
build_unet5d_wrapper: build a 5D UNet wrapper that processes spatial-temporal tensors with optional DiT layers
create_discrete_classifier: create a discrete input classifier using transformer or UNet backbones for sequence or spatial data
run_discrete_classifier: run the discrete classifier to produce logits over vocabulary for 2D sequence or 4D spatial inputs
